dish_en: Pasolla (canned white beans in tomato sauce, breakfast)
source_site: cookpad.com (last resort; no canned-bean breakfast recipe found on Shamlola, Sayidaty, Manal)
servings_stated: not stated (a '5' appears near the ingredients, possibly 5 servings)
method: Blend the onion, garlic and tomatoes in a blender. Pour into a pan with vegetable oil over heat (no heat level given). Add tomato paste, the spices, the canned beans, the hot pepper and a little hot water.
Let it simmer and reduce (no minutes given). Just before removing from heat, add a little chopped coriander and stir. Serve with bread or white rice.
verification: Page read fully via WebFetch 2026-10-10. Canned beans confirmed, no meat confirmed. Servings and heat/minutes not stated on page.
notes: Preferred Shamlola recipe (طريقة عمل الفاصوليا البيضاء, https://www.shamlola.com/recipes/طريقة-عمل-الفاصوليا-البيضاء) is a dried-bean stew with meat stock, 25-30 min simmer, not a canned breakfast dish. Sayidaty node/36520 (الفاصوليا البيضاء بالصلصة) is also dried beans (12 h soak). Cookpad 25119001 (إيناس الشناوى) is dried beans too. Supermama 'الفاصوليا المعلبة' uses 2 cans beans in tomato sauce but is a very spicy Cajun-style lunch dish. The chosen cookpad recipe is the only simple canned-white-bean tomato sauce recipe found; omit the hot pepper for a mild household version. Cookpad alternative not read: 2665373 (tooyti hamedi, فاصولياء بيضاء بصلصة الطماطم).

method: Heat the olive oil in a frying pan on the stove (no heat level given) and saute the minced onion until it wilts/softens.

notes: Other Shamlola variants read: 'البيض المقلي بالبصل و الطماطم' (8 eggs, 1.5 onions, 1/3 cup tomato, 90 g feta, butter+olive oil, cover 10 min, serves 4) and 'بيض مقلي بالجبنة' (2 eggs, 2 tbsp milk, 2 tbsp cheddar, cover low heat ~3 min, serves 2). Also 'البيض المخفوق بالحليب' (scrambled with 1 cup milk + lemon, 5 min medium heat). For a plain unbeaten fried egg use B10 (Sayidaty بيض العيون السادة).

source_site: kitchen.sayidaty.net (Shamlola has no plain boiled-egg recipe, only variants)
chef: مطبخ سيدتي (Chef Tips section, no individual author)
method: Choose a pot that fits the number of eggs and place the eggs inside.
Cover the eggs with water (eggs start in cold/room-temperature water) and add the salt.
Set on high heat until the water boils, then lower the heat and simmer for 10 minutes.
Turn off the heat and transfer the eggs to a bowl of cold water (page does not say ice).
Let cool slightly so they peel easily; peel and serve warm.
Page also gives timing after boiling by egg size: large 4-5 min (page inconsistent, 4 in one place), medium 3 min, small 2 min, and notes time depends on whether eggs were refrigerated and pot size.
Faster alternative on page: start eggs in hot water; or pierce each egg with a pin, add 1/2 tsp baking powder, boil 1 min, remove from heat, cover and rest 10 min.
Microwave alternative on page: about 12 minutes, eggs well covered with water, watch closely to avoid bursting.
verification: Page read fully via WebFetch 2026-10-10. Published 2023-04-06. Page does not use soft/medium/hard terminology; size-based timings are internally inconsistent (large 4-5 vs 4 min).
notes: Shamlola alternative read: 'بيض مسلوق فى الميكروويف' (1 egg, 1/8 tsp white vinegar, 1/3 cup water, microwave 1 min, serves 2; URL https://www.shamlola.com/recipes/طريقة-عمل-بيض-مسلوق-فى-الميكروويف). Other Shamlola boiled-egg pages are stuffed/salad/tuna variants, not plain.

method: Put the olive oil in a wide skillet over medium heat and let it heat.

Add a quarter of the liver and stir gently until its liquid dries; add the rest of the liver gradually, stirring, until each added batch dries. Leave on the heat until all the liver's water has evaporated completely.
Add the salt, black pepper, minced chili and pomegranate molasses. Cook on low heat for 1-2 minutes so the liver absorbs the molasses flavour.
Transfer to a serving dish, sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately with Arabic bread and fried potatoes.
